## 分发

- Package: `@openclaw/google-meet`
- Install route: npm or ClawHub: `clawhub:@openclaw/google-meet`

## Surface

- CLI commands: `openclaw googlemeet`
- Contracts: `tools`, `transcriptSourceProviders`
